questions.question: Where is UPES located?
questions.approvedAnswer: UPES is located in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, with its campuses in the Bidholi and Kandoli areas of Dehradun.

questions.question: What are the rankings of UPES?
questions.approvedAnswer: UPES is ranked No. 1 among private universities in India for Academic Reputation in the QS World University Rankings 2026. It is also ranked 163rd in Asia and 24th in South Asia in the QS Asia University Rankings 2026. In NIRF 2025, UPES is ranked 45th among universities in India.

questions.question: Is UPES recognised?
questions.approvedAnswer: Yes. UPES is a UGC-recognised private university, established through the UPES Act, 2003 of the State Legislature of Uttarakhand.

questions.question: Tell me about BBA.
questions.approvedAnswer: BBA at UPES is a 3-year undergraduate programme that provides students with theoretical and practical knowledge of business and management. The programme covers areas such as finance, marketing, economics, accounting and organisational management, along with opportunities for practical and industry exposure.

questions.question: What is the eligibility for BBA?
questions.approvedAnswer: To be eligible for BBA at UPES, candidates need a minimum of 50% marks in Classes X and XII.
